title: fix(app-shell): the designer's unknown-value flags read in the designer's locale (objectui#9652)
body:
Fixes #9652

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

A designer picker that holds a stored value its roster does not offer still shows that value, flagged with the reason. The flag was an English template literal at each site, so a zh-CN author read `(not found)`, `(not in object)` or `(deprecated)` on an otherwise Chinese inspector. The designer catalogue (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) already carried `engine.form.notInObject` in en and zh, and `widgets.tsx` already used it.

## Sites (re-derived by grep on `origin/main` at the base `3335767b4`)

| site | flag | now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `ViewColumnInspector` field picker | `(not in object)` | `engine.form.notInObject` (existing row, unchanged) |
| `ViewVariantInspector` view type | `(not found)` | `engine.form.notFound` (new) |
| `FlowNodeConfigField` select branch | `(deprecated)` | `engine.form.deprecated` (new) |
| `FlowObjectListField` select cells | `(deprecated)` | `engine.form.deprecated` |
| `InspectorSelectField` default (`_shared.tsx`) | `(not found)` | `engine.form.notFound` |

`ActionDefaultInspector` only mentions `VALUE (not found)` in a comment. Its `ActionTargetField` passes no `unknownValueLabel`, so it shows the `_shared.tsx` default, which is now translated.

Two sites of the same class that the seat's list did not name. Both are outside this claim's file surface, so they are **not** touched here. They are listed in the report for the seat:
- `FlowReferenceField.tsx`, org-membership-level select: `label: \`${current} (invalid)\``
- `HookDefaultInspector.tsx`, object picker: `label: \`${n} (not published)\``

## Decisions, each measured

- **Keys.** `(not in object)` now uses the existing `engine.form.notInObject`. Its value is unchanged, so the bare-suffix readers in `widgets.tsx` (which draw it in a muted span of its own) keep working. The catalogue had no row meaning "not found" or "deprecated" (grep of both tables for `not found`, `deprecated`, `未找到` and `弃用`). One key was added for each, as bare suffixes shaped like `notInObject`: `engine.form.notFound` = `(not found)` / `（未找到）` and `engine.form.deprecated` = `(deprecated)` / `（已弃用）`. `未找到` is the zh pack's own word for "not found" (`未找到选项`, `未找到记录`). The catalogue carries en and zh only, and every new key has a value in both.
- **Word order.** The catalogue's `tFormat` interpolates single-brace `{token}` holes. `engine.form.notInObject` is a bare suffix, and its value cannot take a `{value}` hole without changing `widgets.tsx`. So the value and its flag are joined by one template, `engine.form.flaggedValue`: en `{value} {flag}`, zh `{value}{flag}`. The zh template drops the space because every zh flag opens with a full-width bracket. That is the catalogue's own zh convention (`component_id（此页面暂无组件）`), and a `${v} (flag)` literal at the call site could not express it. This adds three keys, one more than "one key each": the template is the word-order key that the open point asked for. The helper is `flagUnknownValue(value, flag, locale)` in `_shared.tsx`, a one-line `tFormat` call.
- **How the locale is obtained. No new plumbing.** The three sites that already had a `locale` prop (`ViewColumnInspector`, `ViewVariantInspector`, `FlowNodeConfigField`) translate with that prop. Two places have no `locale` prop: `InspectorSelectField`'s default and `FlowObjectListField`. They read `useMetadataLocale()`, the hook that the designer's shared editors already read when no prop reaches them (`widgets.tsx`, `SchemaForm.tsx`, and `ConditionBuilder.tsx` in this same directory). Every production host (`ResourceEditPage`, `StudioDesignSurface`, `ObjectActionsPanel`) derives the `locale` prop it hands to inspectors from that same hook.
- **The `_shared.tsx` default.** It is translated. The other route would have been a `locale` prop on `InspectorSelectField`, but that needs a `locale` argument at each of the call sites that pass no `unknownValueLabel`, which are in other inspector files outside this claim. The hook covers them with no call-site edit.

## Pins

The new file is `inspectors/unknownValueFlag.i18n-9652.test.tsx`, with 14 cases. For each site it has one render-level zh case and one en case, and it reads the rendered trigger or option text:
- zh expectations are the value followed directly by the catalogue's zh flag. A guard proves each flag row is a real zh value: not the key echoed back, not the English value, and opening with a full-width bracket.
- en expectations are the pre-fix literals byte for byte (`amount (not in object)`, `legacy_board (not found)`, `sms (deprecated)`, `role (deprecated)`, `retired_group (not found)`).
- The prop-channel sites pass `locale` with no provider. The hook-channel sites mount `I18nProvider` in the language under test.

No existing test was rewritten or deleted. None of them asserted an English flag under a zh locale: every existing literal assertion (`ReportDefaultInspector.test.tsx`, `FlowNodeInspector.declaredDefault.test.tsx`, `FlowNodeConfigField.test.tsx`, `FlowObjectListField.select.test.tsx`, the `_shared.*` and `ViewColumnInspector.*` suites) renders en.

## Reverse proof (run at `ff58a68b1`, which has the same code as the head; the next commit adds only the changeset)

Mutations were made through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each anchor hit exactly once, the blob changed, the file was restored to its HEAD blob afterwards, and `git diff HEAD` was empty:
- **A.** `ViewColumnInspector` back to `` `${v} (not in object)` ``: `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed | 12 skipped`. The zh case failed with `Expected: "amount（不在对象中）" Received: "amount (not in object)"`, and the en case stayed green.
- **B.** The `_shared.tsx` default back to `` `${v} (not found)` ``: `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed | 11 skipped`. The zh default case failed with `expected 'retired_group (not found)' to be 'retired_group（未找到）'`, and the en and caller-override cases stayed green.

## Verification (head `f96ee760a`)

- `vitest run` on `metadata-admin/inspectors/` (all of it) plus `check-i18n-{designer-table-parity,dead-keys,call-site-keys,en-drift}.test.ts`, `perm-home-namespace-3546`, `objectView-config-keys-retired-4730`, `block-config-i18n`, `block-config`, `studio-locale.i18n` and the console `preview-samples-designer-options`: `Test Files 100 passed (100)`, `Tests 1570 passed | 1 skipped`.
- `vitest run` on tests that render these inspectors from outside the directory: `studio-design/` (all of it), both `ViewConfigPanel` suites, `ResourceEditPage.defaultGate`, `ConditionalFormattingEditor.celGate`, `FieldsListEditor.retiredAliases`, `view-column-io.retiredAliases`, `page-schema`, `ViewRefWidget` and four designer i18n tests: `Test Files 73 passed (73)`, `Tests 401 passed`.
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2` built 28 of 28 tasks. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0. `--listFilesOnly` confirms the test tsconfig includes the new test file.
- These gates exited 0: `check:i18n-designer-parity` ("Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."), `check:i18n-drift` (designer table: 3 keys added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-keys`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `check:test-path-roots`.
- `check:changeset-claims` reported three pending changesets that name `i18n.ts`: `6310-designer-formula-key-retired`, `7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired` and `8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud`. I read each paragraph, and all stay true: the keys they name are untouched and still present.
- Lint was a proven narrowing, not a repo-wide run. `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 7 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files gave 7 files, 0 errors and 12 warnings. The population comes from eslint's own config: `calculateConfigForFile` does not ignore these files, and `languageOptions.parserOptions.project` is null. Invariance: type-aware linting is off, and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads other files, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- One new lint warning: `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the exported `flagUnknownValue`. `_shared.tsx` already exports non-component helpers such as `rosterFrom` and `uniqueId` under the same warning, and `lint.yml` sets no `--max-warnings` on purpose.
- The console preview gallery's `?locale=zh-CN` forces the `locale` prop without switching the i18n language. There, the two hook-read flags follow the i18n language, as `SchemaForm` and `widgets.tsx` already do on that page. Production hosts get both from the same hook.
- `defaultRosterFailureLabel` stays raw English. Every current `roster` caller passes `t('engine.form.optionsLoadFailedTitle', …)`, so nothing renders it. Its comment is reworded because the old one called the module locale-free.
